commits.method: UTC author date; outside authors out; commits_landed = non-merge on main/master, copies of one change collapsed; commits_all_refs = every commit on a branch, remote or tag, merges included; private repos fold into Other private work

trading_bot.method: One window = 7,200 blocks (about one day) after the first. Net = value change of every token the bot moved, priced 5 minutes after each trade, day trend removed, minus builder tips and gas of the bot and of the firm's other contracts. Ranges: bootstrap of days (4,000 resamples, seed 1).
